technical.summary: Strong intermediate trend structure with golden cross and bullish candlestick pattern, but short-term overbought conditions and negative money flow signals warrant caution on immediate entry.

fundamental.summary: MU shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 47 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — moderate amounts, senior member (McCaul), but aged 114-175 days
sentiment.summary: Moderate congressional buying from senior member combined with market fear (31 VIX-equivalent) and neutral AAII sentiment suggests contrarian buy opportunity, though signal age and lack of recent news limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (327.36) with imminent CPI event (0 days) creates acute macro stress; normal yield curve provides limited offset; 47-day earnings window adds secondary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + three white soldiers pattern with 15x volume spike provides intermediate trend confirmation, supported by contrarian congressional buying and fear-zone market conditions (31 VIX equivalent) that historically precede reversals.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro stress (VIX crisis at 327.36, imminent CPI event), pervasive short-term overbought conditions (RSI-9, StochRSI, Williams %R), negative money flow (CMF, AO), weak fundamentals (score 3, high earnings risk in 47 days), and price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA create a hostile entry environment despite technical pattern strength.

decision.entry_rationale: While golden cross and three white soldiers provide intermediate bullish structure, extreme macro stress (VIX crisis, imminent CPI), pervasive short-term overbought conditions, and weak fundamentals (score 3) create a hostile risk/reward environment that outweighs technical pattern strength.
decision.primary_risk: Acute macro volatility from CPI event combined with VIX crisis regime could trigger sharp reversal, especially given price positioning in middle of range and negative money flow signals.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, risk, and debate agents all converge on bear case; sentiment provides only weak contrarian offset
decision.portfolio_note: Existing MU position plus 62 open IT positions (14% of portfolio) argue for concentration reduction; skip entry preserves dry powder for higher-conviction setups.
